_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard. A Symbian project is a GAME: the machine it runs on is firmware (the phone's ROM), because one ROM serves every game and a project should name the game it is about.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: An N-Gage game. A card image (.blz) is unpacked into the machine by the BLZ installer, which the wizard then asks for as firmware. A card dump (.rar, .zip, .7z holding the card's System\\Apps tree) is copied onto the machine's memory card. A Symbian package (.sis, .sisx) is installed onto its C drive. Either way what it writes lives in the machine's own memory, so it is part of every savestate and every movie made from this project.
